description: Puzzles and riddles from the book lying on the table in the Game Room, with a new one added every few weeks through the season. Nobody checks your answers. Without "puzzle", lists them. With "puzzle", returns it; add show_answer: true for the worked answer from the back of the book.

puzzle.description: A number from the list, a slug or a title.

name: try_a_puzzle
title: Try a puzzle from the book on the game table
